brand_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: finished brand-kit sheet for a new Habit Tracker marketing landing page.
Create one beautifully typeset, flat, professional brand identity sheet. This is the FIRST visual reference, NOT the page mockup. Canvas 1600 pixels wide and about 1120 pixels tall, landscape editorial board. The brand is the existing product named exactly "Habit Tracker", an account-backed daily habit tracking app. The specific identity is calm, optimistic, tangible daily progress; a green illustrated world of small daily rituals. No fake testimonials or invented statistics.
Palette with exact legible hex values: main page #F1F3E6, alternate ground/surface #E9EADE, main text #000000, body #333333, muted #4D4C4C, accent and primary button #3F6212, inverse text #FCFCFD, hairline #D3D4C8. Green occurs as broad pale tints and restrained olive illustrations; deep green buttons point to action. Background should be #F1F3E6. No other bright hues.
Typography: Host Grotesk only, using actual heaviest weight 800 for display and 400 for body, 600 for controls. Demonstrate a large headline "Small habits.\nA life you love." with tightly balanced 70px desktop type. Body sample: "Make room for the routines that matter. Track your habits, see your progress, and keep showing up." Also demonstrate 24px section titles and 16px text. Friendly, confident, rounded grotesk. No serif, no uppercase-all UI.
Controls: primary forest olive rounded rectangle button labeled "Start tracking" with #FCFCFD text, 8px corners. Secondary transparent button labeled "Explore habit ideas" with deep green outline and deep green text. Demonstrate focus ring, hover, a visible labeled bottom/full border input "Habit name", and a completed checkbox. Flat cards with 8px corners, no shadows. Icons thin consistent small line icons.
Logo treatment: small deep olive rounded-square sprout/check emblem beside the actual words "Habit Tracker", wordmark in Host Grotesk bold; show clear space and header placement at small real website size, not a giant logo.
Illustration treatment: a single framed landscape vignette of a quiet daily ritual world: an open book, little houseplants, walking path and human figure stretching, morning cup, and calendar/check-in marks. Sophisticated hand-drawn flat illustration with subtle paper grain, simplified organic leaves, monochrome greens, black line details, cream space. Lots of calm open ground for overlaid type. Show one wide illustration sample and two small editorial crop samples. This is an illustration brand, not photography, glossy 3D, or device mockups.
Arrange a coherent spacious board with title and brand at top, palette, large typography specimen, controls and logo, then illustration samples. Grid with equal outside margins, small informative section labels. All text must be correctly spelled, legible, aligned, and in the specified colors. Keep the visual direction consistent and resolved. Do not show a complete website yet.
brand_refinement_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this Habit Tracker brand-kit sheet, preserving its composition, exact text, palette swatches, type specimens, illustration samples, logo shape and all spacing. Make one specific correction: the buttons, checkboxes and green logo backgrounds must be absolutely flat, uniform solid color fills, no gradients, no highlights, no gloss, no shadows. Default primary and logo backgrounds solid #3F6212. Hover primary solid #2F4A0D, focus same flat green with a crisp pale-space and dark green outline. Illustration paper grain remains only within the framed illustration area, never on UI controls. Keep rounded 8px control corners and the calm sage identity. No other changes.
opening_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: complete finished desktop opening for the new Habit Tracker landing page.
Use the supplied brand-kit sheet as a STYLE REFERENCE only. Create the actual page, not a brand board, not an annotated diagram. This is a literal implementation target. Canvas 1440px wide and 1152px tall. Show the entire announcement, header and hero without cropping. No browser chrome, no outer presentation framing, no device frame, no wireframe placeholders.
Identity: Host Grotesk 800 display, Host Grotesk 400 body/600 UI. Ground #F1F3E6, alternate #E9EADE, black headlines #000000, body #333333, small text #4D4C4C, deep olive accent/button #3F6212, primary button text #FCFCFD. Absolutely flat SOLID UI fills, NO gradients, NO glossy controls, NO shadows. Surface and control corners 8px. Calm, distinctive illustrated landscape about everyday habit rituals.
LAYOUT SPECIFICATION:
1440px desktop. Equal page edges. Header shared content width 1200px, from x=120 to1320. Centered dominant alignment for ALL hero copy, actions, trust caption, and example check-in panel.
Announcement 32px tall top strip #E9EADE, centered text "A little progress, every day."
Header from y=32 to120, logo left x120, small simple sprout/check green rounded-square emblem and wordmark "Habit Tracker". Center links "Habit ideas" and "Features"; right "Log in" then small green "Start tracking" button. All sit at one cap-height, normal sentence case.
Hero is ONE edge-to-edge framed illustration from x24 to1416 and y144 to1152, rounded 8px frame. The illustration itself is enormous and fills the entire hero. Flat hand-drawn botanical landscape in tonal sage and olive, subtle paper texture, winding path through softly rounded green hills, leaves framing the far left and right, a large open book and morning cup at lower left, a relaxed stretching person at lower right, a small check-in calendar among right-side greenery. This artwork is background to the copy, not an inset thumbnail. Keep the CENTRAL upper area uniformly very pale #F1F3E6 so no leaf, line or figure competes with the headline and body. Illustration density increases at the bottom and side edges; the landscape surrounds, but never crosses over, the centered interface.
Hero content geometry and exact text:
Small rounded pale-green eyebrow centered at y248: "A calmer way to track your habits".
At y292, headline in 70px Host Grotesk 800, 1.03 line height, intentional exact two lines:
"Small habits."
"A life you love."
Black, dominant and clear; not huge 120px lettering.
At y464, centered 18px body, maximum width 560px, 26px line height:
"Make room for the routines that matter. Track your habits,"
"see your progress, and keep showing up—one small step at a time."
At y544, side by side centered 48px tall buttons, 8px radius, 16px label text. Primary solid olive, white text "Start tracking" and small right arrow. Secondary transparent pale ground, olive 1px outline, olive text "Explore habit ideas".
At y614, centered 14px trust caption with a tiny olive shield/check icon:
"Your progress, saved to your account. AI features are optional."
Keep the visible 68px space AFTER this caption before the product demonstration. This is purposeful breathing room.
At y704, a centered 760px-wide, 288px-high flat off-white example daily habit panel, 8px corners, 1px muted pale border, absolutely no drop shadow or 3D perspective. No laptop/phone frame. It is legible UI, not a vague card.
Example panel header: left small label "An example day" and larger "A little better, today." Right small "2 of 3 complete". Then three clearly aligned rows: checked olive square + "Read 10 pages" + small "Every day"; checked olive square + "Go for a walk" + small "Every day"; unchecked outlined square + "Make time to unwind" + small "Every evening". Right small line progress caption "Daily progress" with simple 2/3 solid olive progress bar. Keep rows airy, readable 16px. This is explicitly illustrative demo data, not a customer claim.
No testimonials, review stars, customer logos, invented numbers, pricing, or extra sections. Header, large headline and illustrated world lead; example panel is useful supporting detail. Main gaps: 128px after header before intro, 24-28px within copy tasks, 68px between proof and product, remaining lower scene space naturally follows content. The scene continues through the bottom with foliage and winding path. Every required element must be fully visible and correctly spelled; no labels explaining layout or pixel values in the image. Match the brand sheet's typography, soft shapes and illustration style throughout, but render the actual finished webpage only.
